id: title:Gilbert09:implement the cisco meraki import source

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Cisco Meraki warehouse ingestion capability, allowing PostHog users to import network and device inventory data from Cisco Meraki dashboards into warehouse tables.
review.reason: The change implements a new warehouse source connector for Cisco Meraki. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 establish the registry entry and documentation for the resource types. P1.F5.H2 provides the core connector implementation. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 maintenance-only characteristics are present. No unobsoded
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and test execution are not fully represented in the supplied hunk descriptions, though the class definition and configuration are present. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 maintenance-only characteristics are present. No unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete implementation of a Cisco Meraki warehouse source. No other unrelated PRs are present, so no uncertainty exists. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.

observations.behavior: Adds Cisco Meraki as a warehouse source, including its metadata, API configuration, credential validation, and endpoint definitions.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds Cisco Meraki to the warehouse ingestion source registry, allowing PostHog to ingest Meraki-managed network and device inventory into warehouse tables.

observations.behavior: Replaces Cisco Meraki with Clarifai in a comment, while adding Clarifai to the registry; Cisco Meraki is not removed, only its mention in this comment is removed.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the warehouse source registry; Cisco Meraki remains available, while Clarifai is added. No removal of Cisco Meraki implementation.

observations.behavior: Defines canonical descriptions and documentation URLs for Cisco Meraki warehouse resources (networks, devices, inventory, uplinks, alerts).
